dict.string: FightCamp Wizard needs access to your camera to let you take a profile picture.

FightCamp Wizard reads HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, workouts, body mass, VO2 Max, wrist temperature, respiratory rate, steps and active energy from Apple Health to compute a personalised Fight Form recovery and readiness score and tailor your camp coaching. Data is never used for advertising or sold.
FightCamp Wizard does not currently write data to Apple Health; this entry is required by Apple because the HealthKit framework includes write APIs even when only read access is used.
FightCamp Wizard needs access to your microphone to allow you to log food and training notes via voice dictation.
FightCamp Wizard needs access to save photos to your library.
FightCamp Wizard needs access to your photo library to let you upload a profile picture.
FightCamp Wizard uses speech recognition to convert your voice into session notes.
